title: Synthesis, characterization, and anticancer activity of tuna bone gelatin peptide-stabilized selenium nanowires
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48958-48968
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06829K, Paper

Muhammad Babar Khawar, Kamaran Khursheed Dar, Ali Afzal, Aisha Munawar, Muhammad Waqas Ishaq, Fakhar Zaman
Tuna-bone gelatin peptides formed stable selenium complexes confirmed by FTIR, DLS, and SEM. TBGP@Se reduced viability of A549 and HT-29 cells in a dose-dependent manner, highlighting its anticancer potential.
